sources.title: ADIOS2 supported engines
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: PnetCDF 非阻塞 I/O：聚合請求與緩衝生命週期
related.titleEn: PnetCDF nonblocking I/O: request aggregation and buffer lifetimes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每種政策附資料完整性條件，不能只交付平均吞吐。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each policy includes completeness conditions, not only mean throughput.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「PnetCDF 非阻塞 I/O：聚合請求與緩衝生命週期」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付請求區間、待完成表、資料校驗與兩項時間分解。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct PnetCDF nonblocking I/O: request aggregation and buffer lifetimes with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver request intervals, outstanding tables, data checks and two-part timing breakdowns.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每秒加入十步取走八步，從空隊列畫到二十步。
分開計算一百次啟動與一次總資料傳輸，不使用檔案大小當操作數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Add ten and remove eight steps each second, starting empty and ending at twenty.
Separate one hundred startups from total transferred bytes; file size is not operation count.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Spack 環境：鎖定依賴 DAG 與建置關鍵路徑
related.titleEn: Spack environments: locked dependency DAGs and build critical paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每種政策附資料完整性條件，不能只交付平均吞吐。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each policy includes completeness conditions, not only mean throughput.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Spack 環境：鎖定依賴 DAG 與建置關鍵路徑」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付DAG、lock摘要、cache來源與兩組關鍵路徑。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Spack environments: locked dependency DAGs and build critical paths with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver DAGs, lock summaries, cache provenance and both critical paths.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每秒加入十步取走八步，從空隊列畫到二十步。
畫兩分支在前置後並行，BLAS使用已存在工具鏈；兩者完成才做整合驗證及app。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Add ten and remove eight steps each second, starting empty and ending at twenty.
Draw both branches after setup, with BLAS using an existing toolchain; both finish before integration validation and the app.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
